notes.title: HAPPY SAMHAIN
notes.content:
Happy Samhain!

Samhain is an Irish traditional celebration that came to be known everywhere as the Halloween season! It's the time when the boundaries between worlds are thinned so you can travel between realms and face all the dangers that come with this ability. 

Loop is about that. It draws inspiration from the eerie and mysterious world of dark Irish mythology, where ancient spirits, otherworldly creatures, and haunting legends come to life. 

Join Deirdre on this journey into the unknown and follow her adventures with the Loop's atmospheric storytelling during Samhain this year! 

Oíche Shamhna Shona Daoibh!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233970/Loop/

notes.title: UPDATE #2
notes.content:
[b]Thank you for all your feedback and support![/b]

We're committed to making our game the best experience possible, and with your help, we've addressed several key issues. Here's what's been improved in the latest update:

[list]
[*] Improved game optimization for smoother performance.
[*] Increased the speed of the auto-skip button for a more seamless experience.
[*] Fixed bugs related to achievement unlocking for one of the endings.
[/list]
We appreciate your continued input and look forward to hearing more from you!

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.content:
We’ve introduced a new Auto-Skip feature, designed especially for players who love exploring every possible ending. This feature becomes available in the OPTIONS menu after you’ve completed the game for the first time.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45210834/2c7b35f7f61fd69b3d7db428f2240f1ef30b6390.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45210834/a68215d2e75875ffecab8956f710ff7d4a43d81d.png[/img]

However, we encourage you to approach the story with a fresh perspective each time. Sometimes, taking a break and coming back to the game later can offer a rich experience as you explore new paths.

Thank you everyone who plays the game and reviews it!

notes.title: VISUAL NOVEL LOOP WHICH IS BASED ON IRISH MYTHOLOGY WILL BE RELEASED ON OCT. 8
notes.content:
We proud to introduce our very first video game on Steam!

This visual novel follows the journey of a young Irish woman, Deigdra, who is trying to rescue her love in a mysterious Irish forest. Along the way, she encounters fairy-tale creatures—some who may help her, and others who might not. Throughout the game, you'll experience moments that will make you laugh, cry, and feel deeply connected to Deigdra's story.

This short visual novel is the perfect companion for any cozy, quiet October evening with a cup of tea or hot chocolate by your side.

Please feel free to add it to your wishlist.
Release date: October 8.
